args:
# Plugin-root lookup. Order: PLUGIN_ROOT; then CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, CURSOR_RULES_DIR, PI_PLUGIN_ROOT with the one matching SO_PLATFORM moved to the front (the env order of resolvePluginRoot() in scripts/lib/plugin-root.mjs § TIER ORDER, values trimmed); then the global npm install, looked up from /; then the client plugin caches under $HOME (newest by mtime, package.json name checked). The directory the client runs in is never a candidate. The differences from resolvePluginRoot() are listed in that file: change both together.
t(){ local v="$1"; v="${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; printf '%s' "${v%"${v##*[![:space:]]}"}"; }
r=""; ch="$(t "$CODEX_HOME")"; [ -n "$ch" ] || ch="$HOME/.codex"; e="CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT CURSOR_RULES_DIR PI_PLUGIN_ROOT"
case "$(t "$SO_PLATFORM")" in codex) e="CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT CURSOR_RULES_DIR PI_PLUGIN_ROOT";; cursor) e="CURSOR_RULES_DIR CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT PI_PLUGIN_ROOT";; pi) e="PI_PLUGIN_ROOT CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT CURSOR_RULES_DIR";; esac
for n in PLUGIN_ROOT $e; do c="$(t "${!n}")"; if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ]; then r="$c"; break; fi; done
so_pkg(){ node -e 'process.exit(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")).name==="session-orchestrator"?0:1)' "$1/package.json" 2>/dev/null; }
g="$(cd / && npm root -g 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$r" ] && [ -n "$g" ] && [ -f "$g/session-orchestrator/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ] && so_pkg "$g/session-orchestrator"; then r="$g/session-orchestrator"; fi
if [ -z "$r" ]; then for b in "$ch" "$HOME/.claude"; do for c in "$b"/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/*; do if [ -f "$c/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ] && so_pkg "$c" && { [ -z "$r" ] || [ "$c" -nt "$r" ]; }; then r="$c"; fi; done; done; fi
if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/scripts/mcp-server.sh"; fi
{ echo "session-orchestrator: cannot locate the plugin root — the MCP server did not start."; echo "  Tried: PLUGIN_ROOT=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT=${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CURSOR_RULES_DIR=${CURSOR_RULES_DIR:-(unset)}, PI_PLUGIN_ROOT=${PI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)} (SO_PLATFORM=${SO_PLATFORM:-(unset)}), global npm install ${g:-(npm root -g failed)}/session-orchestrator, plugin caches $ch/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/* and $HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/*. The working directory ($PWD) is not searched."; echo "  Fix: reinstall the plugin so its cached copy is refreshed (codex plugin marketplace add Kanevry/session-orchestrator), or set PLUGIN_ROOT (or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT) to the plugin directory in this server's env block."; echo "  Note: CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT is session-orchestrator's own compatibility export, not a variable Codex provides. See docs/codex-setup.md § Troubleshooting."; } >&2; exit 1
